email.subject: Your surgery on July 28
email.body:
Eleanor Whitfield,

Your right total hip replacement with Dr. Anil Raman is scheduled for Tuesday, July 28, 2026.

Arrive at 5:45 AM, Surgical Admitting, 2nd floor.
Nothing to eat after midnight. Clear liquids are OK until 3:45 AM.
Take your levothyroxine and amlodipine with a sip of water that morning.
Stop aspirin and fish oil 7 days before (July 21).

Bring your Medicare and Pine Tree Mutual cards, your medication list, and your emergency contact's name and phone number.

Expected stay is one night. Someone must drive you home and stay with you the first night.

email.subject: Your instructions from today's visit with Dr. Raman
email.body:
Hi Eleanor,

It was good to see you walking so well with the cane today. As promised, here are Dr. Raman's instructions in writing:

- Hip precautions continue until your 6-week visit: no bending past 90 degrees, no crossing your legs, no twisting on the operated leg.
- PT at Harbor Physical Therapy twice a week through August, then we'll decide.
- No driving until Dr. Raman clears you at the 6-week visit.
- After your hip replacement, no shoveling or lifting snow this winter, and use the ramp rather than the front steps. Please make arrangements now so you aren't tempted when the first storm comes.
- Call us for redness, drainage, fever over 101, or calf pain or swelling.

Your next appointments: Wednesday 9/9 at 10:20 AM (6 weeks) and Wednesday 10/21 at 1:40 PM (3 months, X-ray first).

Jenna Morin, RN
Nurse Navigator, Casco Bay Orthopedics
(207) 555-0176

email.body:
Eleanor,

Your labs from 9/3 are back. Your TSH is 6.4, up from 3.1 in March, so your thyroid dose is a little low now. Kidney function, blood count and cholesterol all look fine.

I'm increasing your levothyroxine from 75 mcg to 88 mcg. Take one every morning before breakfast with a full glass of water, at least 30 minutes before food or coffee. Keep your calcium at lunch or later. Please don't finish up the old 75 mcg pills.

I sent a 30-day supply to Hannaford Pharmacy on Cottage Road. We'll recheck the TSH in 6 weeks. The front desk will call to set up the lab and a follow-up with me.

Dr. Helen Marsh

turns.text: What would Seaside Commons cost a year if I took the apartment, not counting the entrance fee?
At $3,980 a month for H-314, that's $47,760 a year. Kathleen's email says that covers one meal a day, weekly housekeeping, utilities except phone, and the shuttle.
And roughly what does the house cost me now? Oil, CMP, water, plowing, taxes.

Over the last 12 months: Dunlap oil and tune-up about $3,150, Central Maine Power about $1,290, Casco Water District about $240, Pelletier Plowing $475, and property tax $4,836. That's about $9,990 a year, before groceries, house insurance and repairs.
Keep this between us. Don't put anything about it on the family calendar.
Understood. I won't put anything about Seaside Commons on the shared family calendar.
Set a reminder every morning at 7 for my thyroid pill. It's the new 88 one.
Done. Every day at 7:00 AM: "Thyroid pill, levothyroxine 88 mcg, before breakfast." Would you like a second nudge at 7:30 so you know when it's OK to have coffee?
No, just the one. And take off the old reminder for the 75.
Removed the old 75 mcg reminder. You now have just the 7:00 AM reminder for the 88 mcg.
What did I pay Dunlap for the furnace cleaning last year and who came?
Rick Thibodeau did the tune-up on October 16, 2025. It was $189, paid on your Visa ending 7752. His note said the circulator pump should be replaced in 2 to 3 years.
Who's driving me to PT this week and next?
Joan is taking you Tuesday, October 6, pickup at 2:10. Peg starts Tuesday, October 13, also 2:10. On October 20 you'll see Marcus Leclair because Tasha is out that week.
Put Peg on the calendar for the 13th, the 20th and November 3rd.
Done. I added "Peg driving, pickup 2:10" to your PT appointments on October 13, October 20 and November 3.
